record.question: In the context of gravitational force and electromagnetic force, consider the following statements: 1. While gravitational force is always attractive, electromagnetic force can be both attractive and repulsive. 2. While gravitational force is only dependent on mass, the electromagnetic force is dependent on both mass and charge. 3. While gravitational force is dependent upon the distance between the two bodies, the electromagnetic force is independent of it. Which of the statements given above is/are correct?
